step3.title: Processing status
step3.help: YOLO defect detection per frame. This screen polls while the pipeline is busy.

unqueued.hint: They stay pending until processing is queued — nothing is coming for them in the meantime.
unqueued.hintAction: Go back to the upload step and press “Start processing”: the frames are then queued without being re-uploaded.
